caption: A desk lamp is moved closer to an open book, and the page becomes brighter.

sa.check: A desk lamp lights an open book.
The lamp is moved closer to the book.
The lamp moves first and the page brightens with it.

pc.expect: The page brightens as the lamp approaches and would dim as it moved back.
pc.fail: The page stays the same brightness; or dims as the lamp nears; or brightens with the lamp still.

pc.expect: The brightness changes only as the lamp moves.
pc.fail: It flickers with the lamp still; or changes before the lamp moves.

pc.expect: The shadow of the book's edge shifts as the lamp moves.
pc.fail: The shadow stays fixed; or points toward the lamp; or there is no shadow.

pc.expect: The lit area is a soft pool over the book.
pc.fail: It is a sharp spot; or splits; or floods the room.
A second lamp appears; or the book vanishes; or the lamp passes through the book.

pc.expect: The book and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The page changes colour rather than brightness; or the desk changes; or the lamp changes colour.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
